description: Shared by every iglootools project: extend it as github>iglootools/common//renovate/base#v<version>. Grouping and schedules stay in each project, since they differ (config:recommended with one group in most, Nuxt's preset with group:all in alberta-hiking-resources). The reasoning is in guidelines/project-setup/dependency-automation.md and workflows.md.

helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests keeps every `uses:` pinned to a commit SHA with the tag in a trailing comment; without it a newly added `@v1` would silently stay unpinned. It ships in config:best-practices rather than config:recommended, so it is listed here.

minimumReleaseAge holds updates 14 days, to avoid adopting broken releases and to limit supply-chain attacks. timestamp-optional is what stops digest pins from freezing: an update Renovate cannot date, such as pinning a newly added `@v1`, would otherwise stay pending forever.

iglootools' own releases skip the 14-day hold: the hold protects against a broken or malicious release of someone else's code, and these repositories are ours, released and reviewed by the same people who would review the update. Matched by package name, which covers the shared workflows and presets (iglootools/common) and the `iglootools` dev dependency installed from https://github.com/iglootools/common.

customManagers.description: jdx/mise-action's `version:` input pins the mise CLI that CI runs. Renovate's github-actions manager reads no action inputs, so without this the pin would rot silently. Keyed on the `# renovate:` marker rather than on `version:` alone, which would catch every other action's input; mise tags releases vYYYY.M.PATCH, and extractVersionTemplate drops the v the input does not take.

The iglootools command, a dev dependency of every project, Python or not, pinned by tag as a PEP 508 direct reference (iglootools @ git+https://github.com/iglootools/common@vX.Y.Z). No built-in manager moves a git reference there, so without this a bump of common moved the workflows and presets but not the command, leaving the pins disagreeing, which lint-common-pins fails. The shared renovate-mise-lock workflow then runs uv lock on the branch, re-resolving the tag in uv.lock.

dprint's plugins, pinned in dprint.json as npm: specifiers ("npm:@dprint/json@0.26.0"). They are the formatters themselves, versioned apart from the dprint binary mise pins, and no built-in manager is documented to read them, so without this they would rot silently.

packageRules.description: The dependency locks mise writes under .mise/locks/ for npm tools (npm:renovate) are mise's to regenerate when the tool's version in mise.toml moves; Renovate's npm manager would otherwise read their package.json and propose edits to a generated file. A packageRule, not ignorePaths, which would replace config:recommended's own list.
No minimumReleaseAge for iglootools' own repositories: the hold guards against other people's releases, not ours.
